newsitem.title: USA: Wall St seen taking opening cue from U.S. Aug PPI.
newsitem.headline: Wall St seen taking opening cue from U.S. Aug PPI.

text.p: U.S. stocks are looking to the 0830 EDT/1230 GMT release of the August Producer Price Index for their opening direction on Thursday, which if favorable, could propel the Dow into record territory.
The opening was also seen helped by continuing gains in oil shares. Energy prices continued to surge on talk of possible United States' missile attacks on Iraq.
"We're only 24 points from the record high and all eyes are glued on the PPI and initial jobless claims," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
